summary: Click the ground to send a NavMeshAgent there.
overview: Point-and-click movement: click a walkable surface and the attached NavMeshAgent is sent to that point. It is the only thing in the toolkit bridging a raycast to navigation — the grid placer is for snapped placement, not for moving something that already exists.
useCases: Point-and-click movement in an RPG or adventure game.
Ordering a selected unit to a destination in a strategy game.
Moving a companion or pet to a marked spot.

params.tuning: Should match the geometry the NavMesh was baked from. A click that lands off the NavMesh is silently dropped.
Right click is conventional for move orders in strategy games, left in adventure games.

gotchas.title: The click point must be on the NavMesh, not just on a collider
gotchas.body: Raycasting a surface and being able to path to it are different questions. A click on unbaked geometry hits but does nothing.
